conservation.condition_narrative:
7/20/1983 Informal examination by Kimbell conservator, Helen Mar Parkin states: "Condition stable. Needs frame repair. Needs to be taken off view for a considerable time as it apparently has been exhibited frequently (pastel 'fatigue'). STS" 
(Source: Examination Reports from Kimbell Art Museum, no further documentation) 
In 2001, Untitled-No. 3 (My Heart) was put in a protective frame box with amarand glass to prevent it from smearing and flaking.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Museum at Texas Tech in 2025.

cr_data.provenance: Private collection, purchase, 1966; Museum of Texas Tech University, donation, 1971. (Source: Museum at Texas Tech, 2025)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: O'Keeffe says this is a pastel, Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: Label, 'My Heart 1944' [not verified]. Note: O'Keeffe calls this 'My Heart' Not listed in catalogue." Annotation by Stieglitz on 1945 New York (An American Place) exhibition checklist indicates that this work took the place of cat. no. 1062. Reproduced and titled *Two Stones* in *View* (November 1945). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
